about: The agent fairy palette: one entry per agent, shared by the desk fairy (Aitherium/awdesk electron/agent-fairies.json), the aitherium.com web fairy (AitherVeil) and the Discord avatars (D:/aither-media/fairy-avatars/tools/render_fairies.py). Canonical copy: AitherOS/config/agent-fairies.json. color = the Discord role colour; core = the white-hot centre; glow = the outer bloom; wings = petal|swept; ring = a ring-shaped outer glow; sparkles = the owner's glints.

crewColor.rule: An agent with no entry below (a crew agent raising cards) gets ONE stable colour on every surface: h = FNV-1a 32-bit (offset 0x811c9dc5, prime 0x01000193) of the trimmed lowercased name, mod 360; colour = hsl(h, 70%, 60%) as #rrggbb (each channel rounded). Generic harness names (claude-code, claude, codex, agent, session, unknown) are not agents and get no fairy. Every implementation must reproduce these vectors.
